baked-project-objects.pipeline: npm run bake:project-objects: bake node transforms and instance colors into shared model coordinates; tessellate shared horizontal slices and broad triangles for continuous twist deformation; preserve material groups, UVs and normals; weld and Meshopt-compress without position quantization or geometry simplification.

marralhinha-oak.glb.export: Rendered the canonical Board without its table; baked visible meshes, instanced divots and materials with GLTFExporter; added canonical 0.335-radius marbles with marbleSkin and positionIn. Replaced only the bottom caps of the board and four trays with their unperforated outer shapes, retaining the original top, sides, wood UVs and materials. Meshopt-compressed without geometry simplification.

/fonts/project-boot-dela.json.export: TTFLoader outline subset of PROJECTS, for extruded 3D typography.
